case_number: 2025 INSC 233; CIVIL APPEAL NO.2608 of 2025 (@ SPECIAL LEAVE PETITION (C) NO.10088 of 2020)
summary: Forfeiture of gratuity under Payment of Gratuity Act, 1972 s.4(6)(b)(ii) permissible upon proven misconduct constituting offence involving moral turpitude in departmental proceedings; criminal conviction not required; standard of preponderance of probabilities sufficient; C.G. Ajay Babu partially overruled per incuriam; impugned judgments set aside; forfeiture upheld.
legal_provisions_cited: Payment of Gratuity Act, 1972 s.4(5), s.4(6)
Union Bank of India and Ors. vs. C.G. Ajay Babu
Jaswant Singh Gill vs. Bharat Coking Coal Ltd.
Mahanadi Coalfields Ltd. vs. Rabindranath Choubey
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; impugned judgments set aside; forfeiture of gratuity upheld.
